newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong's PX plant starts production.
newsitem.headline: Yukong's PX plant starts production.

text.p: South Korea's Yukong Ltd said on Tuesday it has started full production of its new 300,000 tonnes-a-year paraxylene (PX) plant.
Yukong said in a statement the new 200 billion won plant has raised its total paraxylene output capacity to 650,000 tonnes a year.
The company expects additional production to boost turnover by 150 billion won annually.
Paraxylene is the feed product for telephthalic acid (TPA), which is used to make polyester.
